stdout:
usage: gedo_feedback.py add [-h] --kind {missed-collision,false-collision,merge-fallback,wrong-merge,contract-miss,identity,performance,crash,data-loss,setup,interface,workaround,other} --title TITLE [--severity {critical,high,medium,low}] --scenario SCENARIO --expected EXPECTED --actual ACTUAL [--reproduction REPRODUCTION] [--workaround WORKAROUND] [--command COMMAND]
                            [--gedo-version GEDO_VERSION] [--found-in FOUND_IN] [--related RELATED] [--diagnostics-file DIAGNOSTICS_FILE] [--doctor] [--allow-duplicate]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {missed-collision,false-collision,merge-fallback,wrong-merge,contract-miss,identity,performance,crash,data-loss,setup,interface,workaround,other}
  --title TITLE
  --severity {critical,high,medium,low}
  --scenario SCENARIO   What was being done, and how the work was split
  --expected EXPECTED
  --actual ACTUAL
  --reproduction REPRODUCTION
                        Minimal steps, without proprietary code
  --workaround WORKAROUND
                        What was done instead
  --command COMMAND     The Gedo or Git command involved
  --gedo-version GEDO_VERSION
  --found-in FOUND_IN   Branch, pull request or context
  --related RELATED     Gedo backlog items or proposals, e.g. 'G3, FEAT-074'
  --diagnostics-file DIAGNOSTICS_FILE
                        A log excerpt to attach (last 200 lines)
  --doctor              Attach the output of 'gedo doctor --json'
  --allow-duplicate
